snippet.title: Amanda the Adventurer 3 Console Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Amanda the Adventurer 3 is coming to consoles on May 28th, 2026!

It's finally time to experience the final chapter in the story of Amanda the Adventurer on consoles!
Explore the abandoned Hameln facility, unravel the mysteries behind Kensdale’s beloved children’s show, and above all, Find Her. 

Follow us: https://x.com/AmandaAdvnturer

Join the community: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
